title: This Cave Has 37-Foot Crystals. You Last 10 Minutes Inside

scenes.text: This cave holds crystals nearly as long as a bus, and it can overheat you in minutes.
It's the Cave of Crystals in Naica, Mexico, a thousand feet underground.
Some of the crystals are over 37 feet long.
The air hit 136 degrees, with humidity over 90 percent.
Without a cooling suit, a person can last only about ten minutes.
The crystals grew over hundreds of thousands of years, in water that was never disturbed.

description:
The Cave of Crystals in Mexico holds gypsum crystals up to 37 feet long, in air that reaches 136 degrees.
Without protective gear, people can only stay inside for roughly ten minutes. The crystals grew slowly in hot, mineral rich water for hundreds of thousands of years.
Would you go in? Comment below.
first_comment: The mine pumps were switched off in 2015 and the cave started to flood again. Should we let nature keep it?
